__comment: Combined per manager request: CIFS Connector v1 and v2 are the same connector at two different instrumentation generations (v2 adds ACL/SMB-pool/worker-channel internals on top of the same core files_discovered/processed/scan_duration metrics v1 already had) - not duplicates, so nothing was deduplicated, just laid out under one $datasource client picker with a collapsible section per version. v2's extra $job/$instance/$datasource_id variables didn't collide with anything in v1 (v1 only had $datasource), so no renaming was needed here (contrast with backend-workers.json, where the merged services' $namespace/$pod did collide and had to be renamed). Each file's own internal rows (v1: 6, v2: 5) are preserved as siblings under a plain section-title divider rather than force-wrapped in an outer collapsed row, since Grafana doesn't support nesting a row panel inside another collapsed row's panel list.

targets.expr: sum by (job, operation)(rate(cifs_connector_file_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job="$job", operation!="perm_check"}[1m])) / sum by (job, operation)(rate(cifs_connector_file_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="$job", operation!="perm_check"}[1m]))

sum by (job)(rate(cifs_connector_files_per_scan_sum{job="$job", datasource_id=~"$datasource_id"}[1m])) / sum by (job)(rate(cifs_connector_files_per_scan_count{job="$job", datasource_id=~"$datasource_id"}[1m]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance, operation)(rate(cifs_connector_file_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", operation!="perm_check"}[1m])))

title: NVisionX — CIFS Connector: v1 / v2 (All Clusters)
